newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran mine blast kills 15, injures 29 - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Iran mine blast kills 15, injures 29 - newspaper.

text.p: An explosion at a coal mine in northern Iran has killed 15 people and injured 29, the Iranian daily Ettelaat newspaper said on Monday.
It said the casualties of Sunday's blast were taken to hospital and a team of experts was sent to the mining tunnel at the "Sangrud-e Lowshan" colliery to investigate the incident.

The official news agency IRNA reported earlier on Monday some 150 people had been trapped underground. IRNA quoted an official in Gilan province as saying the blast was caused by an electrical short circuit in the mining tunnel.
It quoted witnesses as saying the explosion trapped around 150 miners in the tunnel.
The agency and the paper gave no other details and it was not immediately clear if the trapped men had been rescued.
